estimand.target: realized y on the test window
estimand.sign: delta > 0 favours Hurdle, delta < 0 favours Point
estimand.not_comparable_with: synthetic rmse_mean_truth (oracle-based); compare direction only, never magnitude or effect size

H1.statement: stronger inter-arrival dependence moves the comparison towards Hurdle

H2.statement: high sparsity + weak occurrence signal + persistent positive magnitude moves the comparison towards Point
H2.test: mean(delta | POINT_CANDIDATE) < mean(delta | CONTROL); stronger replication if mean(delta | POINT_CANDIDATE) < 0

H3.statement: the occurrence-dependence effect is stronger in sparser series
H3.test: Spearman(abs(rho_interval), delta) computed inside HIGH_ADI versus inside LOW_ADI

subgroups.CONTROL: HIGH_ADI and LOW_OCC_SIGNAL and not MAG_PERSISTENT

descriptor_rules.window: train split only, never validation or test
descriptor_rules.rho_interval_train: lag-1 autocorrelation of the inter-arrival gap sequence between consecutive positive events
descriptor_rules.rho_magnitude_train: lag-1 autocorrelation of the positive magnitude sequence in event order, SIGNED
descriptor_rules.ADI_train: segment length / number of positive events
descriptor_rules.nan_policy: NaN correlations stay NaN; they are never filled with zero

eligibility.note: operational threshold for a cheap SCREEN, not a scientific cutoff; a sign flip across thresholds is reported as WARN_DESCRIPTOR_INSTABILITY

leading_zero_policy.m5_availability_definition: first day of the first wm_yr_wk in which sell_prices.csv carries a row for that (store_id, item_id)
leading_zero_policy.favorita_reason: prepare_favorita.py already restricts the pool to series whose first activity is within 90 days, so pre-introduction padding is bounded by construction
leading_zero_policy.prohibition: a zero observed while the item was available is real zero demand and is never removed

bootstrap.note: time rows are never resampled as if independent

models.source: experiments.om_factorization_killtest.train.train_one, imported unchanged from the synthetic study

splits.single_origin_note: a SCREEN uses one pre-fixed origin; a confirmatory run would need every rolling origin
splits.train_origin_stride_reason: SCREEN compute budget; a confirmatory run should use dense origins

stop_rules.on_violation: report INSUFFICIENT_GROUP_N and draw no conclusion

training.checkpoint_rule: validation MSE of the final mean prediction, identical for every DLinear variant
training.hyperparameter_rule: no per-cell tuning; one setting for every cell and every model; TSB alpha/beta chosen on a fixed grid using the validation split only
